coverage: All twenty-five scenes in both original-en and modern-en: named cast, speaking and stage roles, the two royal houses and their dead, the followers of both armies, and the religious and historical figures named in the play.

entities.name: Richard, Duke of Gloucester
entities.body: The youngest of the three York brothers, and the King’s brother.

snapshots.body: The youngest York brother, now proclaimed King Richard the Third.

entities.name: Queen Elizabeth
entities.body: King Edward the Fourth’s queen, mother of the two young princes.

snapshots.body: Widow of King Edward the Fourth, and mother of the two young princes.

entities.name: The Duke of Buckingham
entities.body: A nobleman who becomes Richard’s closest ally.

snapshots.body: Richard’s ally at court, now leaving him and making for Brecknock.

entities.name: Lady Anne
entities.body: Widow of Edward, Prince of Wales, the son of Henry the Sixth.

snapshots.body: Widow of Edward, Prince of Wales, and now wearing Richard of Gloucester’s ring.
Richard’s wife, going to be crowned his queen.

entities.name: The Duchess of York
entities.body: Mother of King Edward, Clarence and Richard.

entities.name: Lord Hastings
entities.body: The Lord Chamberlain, lately released from the Tower.

entities.name: Lord Stanley, Earl of Derby
entities.body: A nobleman of the court, and Richmond’s stepfather.

snapshots.body: Richmond’s stepfather, holding his men back with his son in Richard’s hands.

entities.name: George, Duke of Clarence
entities.body: The middle York brother, sent to the Tower as the play opens.

entities.name: Sir William Catesby
entities.body: One of Richard’s agents at court.

entities.name: Queen Margaret
entities.body: Widow of Henry the Sixth, and the only Lancastrian left at court.

entities.name: Richard, Duke of York
entities.body: King Edward’s younger son, and the Prince’s brother.

entities.name: Earl Rivers
entities.body: Queen Elizabeth’s brother, whose name is Antony Woodville.

entities.name: Prince Edward
entities.body: King Edward’s elder son and heir.

entities.name: Sir Richard Ratcliffe
entities.body: One of Richard’s agents.

entities.name: The Earl of Richmond
entities.body: The Lancastrian claimant, raising an army abroad.

entities.name: King Edward the Fourth
entities.body: The eldest York brother, and the reigning king.

entities.name: Sir Robert Brakenbury
entities.body: The Lieutenant of the Tower.

entities.name: Sir James Tyrrel
entities.body: The gentleman Richard employs for the murder in the Tower.

entities.name: The Marquess of Dorset
entities.body: Queen Elizabeth’s son by her first marriage.

entities.name: The Lord Mayor
entities.body: The Lord Mayor of London.

entities.name: The Duke of Norfolk
entities.body: A nobleman who commands for Richard in the field.

entities.name: Lord Grey
entities.body: Queen Elizabeth’s son by her first marriage.

entities.name: The Bishop of Ely
entities.body: John Morton, Bishop of Ely.

entities.name: The Archbishop of York
entities.body: The archbishop who attends the Queen and the young Duke of York.

entities.name: Cardinal Bourchier
entities.body: The cardinal who fetches the young Duke of York out of sanctuary.

entities.name: Lord Lovell
entities.body: One of Richard’s followers.

entities.name: Sir James Blunt
entities.body: A follower of Richmond’s.

entities.name: Sir Christopher Urswick
entities.body: A priest who carries messages between Stanley and Richmond.

entities.name: The Earl of Surrey
entities.body: Norfolk’s son, in the field with Richard.

entities.name: The Earl of Oxford
entities.body: A follower of Richmond’s.

entities.name: Sir Walter Herbert
entities.body: A follower of Richmond’s.

entities.name: Sir William Brandon
entities.body: A follower of Richmond’s, who bears his standard.

entities.name: George Stanley
entities.body: Lord Stanley’s son, held hostage by Richard.

entities.name: The Boy
entities.body: Clarence’s young son, Edward Plantagenet.

entities.name: The Girl
entities.body: Clarence’s young daughter.

entities.name: The First Murderer
entities.body: One of the two men Richard sends to the Tower for Clarence.

entities.name: The Second Murderer
entities.body: The other of the two men sent to the Tower, and the one who repents.

entities.name: The murderers
entities.body: The two men sent to the Tower, speaking together.

entities.name: The First Citizen
entities.body: A London citizen talking over the King’s death.

entities.name: The Second Citizen
entities.body: A London citizen talking over the King’s death.

entities.name: The Third Citizen
entities.body: The Londoner who reads the danger in the news most clearly.

entities.name: The Keeper
entities.body: The keeper of the Tower who hears Clarence’s dream.

entities.name: The messenger
entities.body: A messenger bringing news to the court and the camps.

entities.name: The Third Messenger
entities.body: A third messenger with news of the risings.

entities.name: The Second Messenger
entities.body: A second messenger with news of the risings.

entities.name: The Pursuivant
entities.body: The officer Hastings meets on his way to the Tower.

entities.name: The Priest
entities.body: The priest Hastings greets in the street.

entities.name: The Sheriff
entities.body: The sheriff who leads Buckingham to execution.

entities.name: The Page
entities.body: Richard’s page, who names Tyrrel to him.

entities.name: The Gentleman
entities.body: A gentleman attending the corpse of Henry the Sixth.

entities.name: The Scrivener
entities.body: The clerk who has engrossed the indictment of Hastings.

entities.name: Tressel
entities.body: A gentleman attending Lady Anne at the funeral.

entities.name: Berkeley
entities.body: A gentleman attending Lady Anne at the funeral.

entities.name: The children of Clarence
entities.body: Clarence’s son and daughter, speaking together.

entities.name: The lords
entities.body: The lords of the council and the court.

entities.name: The halberdiers
entities.body: The guard carrying the corpse of Henry the Sixth and the prisoners to Pomfret.

entities.name: The citizens
entities.body: The citizens of London.

entities.name: The gentlemen
entities.body: The gentlemen attending the funeral.

entities.name: The soldiers
entities.body: The soldiers of the two armies at Bosworth.

entities.name: The attendants
entities.body: The attendants at court.

entities.name: The bishops
entities.body: The two bishops Richard shows himself between at Baynard’s Castle.

entities.name: The house of York
entities.body: The royal house Richard and his brothers belong to.

entities.name: The house of Lancaster
entities.body: The rival royal house, of Henry the Sixth and Richmond.

entities.name: The Plantagenets
entities.body: The royal family both houses descend from.

entities.name: The Guilfords
entities.body: The Kentish family in arms against Richard.

entities.name: King Henry the Sixth
entities.body: The Lancastrian king, whose corpse opens the second scene.

entities.name: Edward, Prince of Wales
entities.body: Henry the Sixth’s son and Lady Anne’s husband, killed at Tewksbury.

entities.name: Edward Plantagenet
entities.body: Clarence’s young son, called Ned.

entities.name: Richard, Duke of York
entities.body: Father of the three York brothers, killed by Margaret’s party.

entities.name: King Richard the Second
entities.body: The king hacked to death at Pomfret, whose castle Rivers names.

entities.name: The Earl of Warwick
entities.body: Lady Anne’s father, who changed sides in the wars.

entities.name: Rutland
entities.body: The Duchess of York’s young son, killed by Clifford.

entities.name: Clifford
entities.body: The Lancastrian who killed the boy Rutland.

entities.name: Mistress Shore
entities.body: The King’s mistress, and afterwards Hastings’s.

entities.name: Lady Lucy
entities.body: A woman Buckingham says King Edward was contracted to before his marriage.

entities.name: Lady Bona
entities.body: The French king’s sister, whom King Edward was to have married.

entities.name: Sir Edward Courtney
entities.body: A Devonshire gentleman risen against Richard.

entities.name: The Bishop of Exeter
entities.body: Courtney’s brother, risen with him in Devonshire.

entities.name: Sir Gilbert Talbot
entities.body: A follower of Richmond’s.

entities.name: Sir William Stanley
entities.body: A follower of Richmond’s, and a kinsman of Lord Stanley’s.

entities.name: The Earl of Pembroke
entities.body: A follower of Richmond’s.

entities.name: Rice ap Thomas
entities.body: A Welsh captain who joins Richmond.

entities.name: Sir Thomas Vaughan
entities.body: A follower of the Queen’s kindred, executed at Pomfret.

entities.name: Dighton
entities.body: One of the two men Tyrrel suborned for the murder in the Tower.

entities.name: Forrest
entities.body: One of the two men Tyrrel suborned for the murder in the Tower.

entities.name: Julius Caesar
entities.body: The Roman said to have built the Tower of London.

entities.name: Humphrey Hower
entities.body: A name Richard invents to put his mother off; no such man exists in the play.

entities.name: Jockey of Norfolk
entities.body: The name in the rhyme left in Norfolk’s tent, meaning Norfolk himself.

entities.name: Dickon
entities.body: The name in the same rhyme, meaning Richard himself.

entities.name: Saint George
entities.body: The patron saint of England, worn as the Garter badge and cried as a battle word.

entities.name: Saint Paul
entities.body: The apostle Richard swears by, and the London church that bears his name.

entities.name: Abraham
entities.body: The patriarch in whose bosom Tyrrel says the princes sleep.

entities.name: Jesus
entities.body: Named in the oaths of the play.

entities.name: Saint John
entities.body: Named in Hastings’s oath.
